verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for an online company-incorporation service, since incorporation platforms can expose programmatic APIs and SDKs. The evidence pack only describes a web-form flow: citizen-card or Chave Móvel Digital authentication, auto-generated pacts, manual payment, and email notifications. Nothing in it documents an API, SDK, or developer library.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
